title: Adic termwise quotient tower of a short complex and its cohomology tower
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $I$ an ideal, and $S=(U\xrightarrow{u}V\xrightarrow{v}W)$ a short complex of $R$-modules, so $vu=0$. Using the canonical quotient functors $Q_k$ and transitions $t_{m,k}$ [def-sf-adic-module-quotient-data], define a functor $\mathbb N^{\mathrm{op}}\to\operatorname{ShortComplex}(\operatorname{Mod}_R)$ whose value at $n$ is the termwise quotient $Q_{n+1}(S)$, and whose map from $m$ to $n$ for $n\le m$ is induced termwise by $t_{m+1,n+1}$. Define its cohomology tower by composing this functor with the short-complex homology functor: its value at $n$ is $\ker(v_{n+1})/\operatorname{im}(u_{n+1})$, with the maps induced by the quotient transitions. These are the existing AdicCohomology.shortComplexTower and AdicCohomology.tower definitions, with unchanged data. No Noetherian or finiteness hypothesis is part of either construction.
